concepts.reader_question: Ai xác nhận số liệu trước giờ chốt?
concepts.description: TARGETED CORRECTION: credible semiconductor shopfloor and accounting handoff context with completely blank record surfaces and neutral person positions separated by a plain open responsibility gap. No question mark in scene, no standalone annotation or any extra character, microglyph, ID, date, cost amount, metric, tick/checkmark/seal or completion icon. Any control surface entirely blank, no UI glyphs. The sole question mark occurs only inside exact approved headline. Print only exact approved headline, complete body, category,4/5 and official supplied logo once. No source or CTA added. Responsibility and confirmation remain open, no invented capability or financial outcome. Semiconductor scene and neutral paths integrated with approved R2 material depth/light, no undeclared composition transfer.

O3-A4.headline: Ai xác nhận số liệu trước giờ chốt?
O3-A4.body: Ai đối chiếu hồ sơ xưởng, ai xác nhận số liệu và thời điểm bàn giao là khi nào? Cần làm rõ trách nhiệm theo quy trình thực tế.
